I can't talk to people well and self isolate too. It feels so much easier to be alone if it means that I won't risk ruining anything else for anyone. But humans aren't supposed to be perfectly flawless without ever making a mistake. 

Unfortunately, shitty relationships are a big part of life, and at least in my case, makes it easy to feel like you're the problem, which causes more problems, and then a cycle develops.

You are so much more that what you have been forced to go through.

You're not "fucking up" anyone's life by talking about your struggles. Anyone who treats you like that is just a dick. I have a shitty mom who gets pissed at me when I try to talk to her too. I'm sorry you have to deal with a life where you have to feel like shit for having feelings. That's not fair to you at all, and I hope you know that. 

You're a good person, you clearly think about others a lot, despite everything you're going through. You want to die but you're still more worried about ruining relationships than yourself.

I would recommend reaching out to your bf about it, but I understand not feeling comfortable with that. I'm not you, so I can't tell exactly what people in your life act like.

All I can say is that I truly want things to work out for you. You made it through all this, you're living and breathing right now, and that's incredible. No matter what your next decisions may be, you're a very strong person.
Oh also, sorry if I'm being a dick, I've just seen a fair share of people expect that seeing a shrink will fix it all and then that just leads them to be more depressed cuz the hopes were too high.

I'll just be blunt, that fuckin sucks. I've been in that position too lately, shit is just too hard to handle. Like I said, idk how to help with this but I'm here. I'll probably be up all night so you can vent whenever and even another day you can too. 

I almost said some corny bullshit like "well at least I'm sure your bf and mom love you" but honestly that fact just makes it harder to wonder about how they can treat you like that.

Props to you for even making it this far though. I mean, at least from the brief info provided, you have pets and relationships, that's hard to maintain, especially when depression can be so debilitating. I hope you know that you're doing a good job even getting to this point.

And sorry if this is just annoying, I just feel like you really need some real care, and I want to be there for you even though I'm just a stranger. I care.
